items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Oh, I'm trying to remember where Eddie South and Billy Taylor were working. They had a trio together.

ctx.x: Can you remember the names of any of the other clubs in that stretch there?

Oh, I'm trying to remember where Eddie South and Billy Taylor were working. They had a trio together. As did Stuff and John Levy. Oh, boy, wait a minute. It was in the area of like the Three Deuces in Chicago, the early Three Deuces, where Art Tatum used to work, and where John Collins worked with Art Tatum for about a year.
